page:
SvelteKit integration for running Elysia on server routes. Create src/routes/[...slugs]/+server.ts file. Define Elysia server. Export fallback function calling app.handle(request). Treat as normal SvelteKit server route.
Questions: How do you run Elysia with SvelteKit? What file structure is needed? How do you export routes?

sections.manifest:
Prefix configuration for non-root routing. If Elysia server placed in src/routes/api/[...slugs]/+server.ts, annotate prefix as /api via `new Elysia({ prefix: '/api' })`. Ensures proper routing regardless of placement location.
Questions: When do you set prefix? How does it ensure correct routing?
